data.gender_notes: Mubtasim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mubtasim is an Arabic name that means 'one who smiles' or 'one who brings joy'. It is a name that symbolizes happiness and positivity. The name Mubtasim carries the meaning “Smiling or Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubtasim usually hope their child will grow to embody smiling or joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, a smiling face is considered a sign of a pure heart and a strong faith.
data.etymology: Mubtasim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Smiling or Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubtasim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مبتسم
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبتسم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ومعناه الشخص الذي يبتسم دائما، ويستخدم هذا الاسم لتحفيز الأطفال على الابتسامة والمرح، وهو من الأسماء النادرة ولكن له أهمية في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: مبتسم
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبتسم ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عربوں کے ناموں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا معنی ہے کہ وہ شخص جو ہمیشہ خوش و خندان رہتا ہے، اور یہ نام برسوں سے مسلمانوں میں استعمال ہو رہا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुब्तसिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुब्तसिम एक इस्लामिक नाम है जो अरबी नामों से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो हमेशा मुस्कराता रहता है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: مبتسم
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبتسم د اسلامي نوم دی چې د عربي نومونو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده چې هغه شخص چې دايم خندونکی درلودونکی دی، او دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې مسلمانانو ترمنځ استعمال کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Mubtasim holds great significance in Arabic and Islamic culture. In the Arabic language, the root "abtasam" means 'to smile,' and the name Mubtasim is derived from this root. This name is often given to newborn babies as it is believed that a smile is the first expression of happiness. Furthermore, in Islamic culture, a name with positive connotations is believed to bring good fortune and blessings to the bearer. Thus, the name Mubtasim is considered an auspicious name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mubtasim holds great significance as it reflects the true nature of Allah (God) towards His creation. Allah is known as the "Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim," meaning the most compassionate and merciful. The name Mubtasim is a reminder of Allah's endless love and compassion towards His creations. It also signifies the importance of spreading joy and happiness in the world and bringing a smile to people's faces. It is a name that encourages the bearer to strive towards spreading positivity and happiness in their lives and in the lives of those around them.
